tensorfold.d: Inference engine by Ash Hart (Apache-2.0 as of v0.6.0) that serves LLMs through an OpenAI-compatible API, on MLX (Mac) and CUDA. Each model family brings its own kernels and its own draft verification. In the GLM recipe, it runs one rank per DGX Spark, plus 53 patches from Mia's AI Lab.

contrato-de-exatidao.d: The three equalities TensorFold guarantees against the same engine, weights and settings: drafted = serial, concurrent = solo and resumed = fresh. It does not promise equality with the BF16 checkpoint when there are lossy defaults (DENSE=q4, KV=fp8, KDA_CHUNKED=1).

hash-de-imagem.d: The first 12 hex digits of the SHA-256 of cat patches/*.patch + IMAGE_EXTRAS. It becomes the tag v0.6.0-<hash> and the label tf.patches: changing a patch changes the hash, and prepare.sh looks for another image or builds one.

refit-de-janela.d: When the requested window does not fit in the memory budget, TensorFold refuses before loading weights and reports the largest window that fits; start.sh reads that line from the log and restarts once with --context N.

pool-compartilhado.d: A single arena of per-token caches (DSA latent and indexer keys) split into extents among up to 4 streams and the kept prompts. In the recipe it grows into whatever is left of the budget, up to KV_POOL_GIB per Spark beyond the window: 2,922,496 tokens in the measured start.

recorte-por-mse.d: Choosing a group's quantization range by testing several clippings of the minimum and maximum and keeping the one with the lowest squared error. In TensorFold's DENSE=q4, 16 clippings from 1.0 to 0.55 per group of 64, with no calibration data.

copy-drafts.d: Drafts from a lookup in the context (prompt lookup): if the last 8 tokens have already occurred in the prompt or the reply, the tokens that came after them become drafts, up to 15 per round; when present, they replace the DFlash2 chain for that round (DFlash2 does not propose). Almost zero cost; they shine in quoting and editing (84 → 119 tok/s).

l2-prefetch.d: A small kernel on a side stream that asks memory to bring into L2 the weights the next kernels will read, taking advantage of phases when DRAM sits idle (all-gathers, glue, router). It does not change bits; on GLM it added ~2% to decode.

pools-visiveis.d: Limiting the DSA indexer's scoring to the complete pools a row can see, \(\min(N_{PS}, \max(\lfloor (P+r+1)/4 \rfloor, K))\), instead of the whole bucket captured in the CUDA graph. It selects the same tokens with less work.

parada-ciente-do-ruido.d: DFlash2's depth policy in TensorFold: since the target's keyed Gumbel noise is known before verification, each draft's confidence is \(\mathrm{softmax}((\text{score}+g)/\beta)\) with \(\beta = 2\); the chain stops when the product of the confidences falls below \(P\) (fnc7:0.3).
